lines.en: My showy tail feathers arch high.
My two feet peck forward in turn.
Three steps, one dip of the head.
I've been hunting the grass a while.
Wings half open to keep my balance.
Even my neck sways with each step.
My fine plumage brushes the grass.
Skipping the coop, I head for the yard.
My claws rake the ground twice.
I break into a trot, tail bouncing.

lines.zh: 站到篱笆桩上看了一眼
lines.en: I hop a fence post for a quick look.
This plumage must not get dirty.
Down, up, down again.
My steps land almost weightless.
I strut toward that worm.
My feathers catch a little shine.
I stand on one leg, the other tucked.
I preen one glossy feather into place.
Head cocked, eyeing you then the grass.
My neck pumps in and out.
I shake out all my feathers.
Two soft clucks in my throat.
My wings lift at my sides.
I've scratched a small hollow in the dirt.
Sun warms my feathers through.
My tail feathers shudder once.
I glance up at the sky.
I stand still at the coop door.
I stretch one wing out sideways.
I dip my head to smooth my breast feathers.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚着一串小声音
lines.en: A little string of notes rolls in my throat.
All my feathers fluff out at once.
One eye is fixed on you.
Head one way, then the other.
Do your shoes smell of bugs?
One step forward, then I stop.
These feathers are here. Don't step.
Don't reach so fast.
I cluck twice at you.
My tail shakes like a boast.
You're twice the height of the coop.
Seen enough. Back to scratching.
I circle in beside your feet.
Then half a step back, wary.
Cluck! That hurt!
A feather came loose.
I flap backward, away.
The flock bursts apart and runs.

lines.zh: 一根华丽羽毛掉了，我抖了抖。
lines.en: A fancy feather falls; I ruffle my wings.
I hunch down, trying to look small.
My cluck comes out cracked.
My legs still hold.
I stagger two steps.
Half my plumage is a mess.
Seeds? Scatter them.
I know those little grains.
One peck, then another.
My plumage must stay clean.
I snatch faster than anyone.
The others are rushing in too.
Peck down, look up.
How many more are in your hand?
I'm at your feet, waiting for more.
Not enough for a whole flock.
For food I'll come close.
Done pecking, I scratch the soil anyway.
I grab the best grain and run.
My wings open a little.
Don't close your hand. I'm still hungry.
Smells like sun-dried grain.
Cluck! You stepped on me.
You've mussed my feathers.
I flap aside in a hurry.
Don't kick. I'll move on my own.
You're too tall to see me down here.
One flap and I land by your foot.
Two steps back, tail flicking.

lines.zh: 这一身羽毛可不好打理
lines.en: This plumage is hard to keep neat.

lines.zh: 碰到我就别再碰第二次
lines.en: Bump me once, not twice.
I yield, but I don't go far.

lines.zh: 把最亮的尾羽翘给她看
lines.en: I raise my glossiest tail feathers for her.
I strut half a circle around her.
I cluck softly, low in my throat.
I spread my wings and give two shakes.
The eggs from this nest will be fine.

lines.zh: 我先替她试试巢的软硬
lines.en: I test the nest's softness for her first.

lines.zh: 啄了一口谷子放她面前
lines.en: I drop a grain at her feet.
My comb is redder than usual.
We crouch together in the fence's shade.
She walks off, and I follow.
One peck and I've got it.
I run two steps with it in my beak.
I drop it, then peck it back up.
Too small to fill my beak.
I tuck it under a grass root.
Nobody's taking this from me.
Swallowed. I wipe my beak.
Took a few pecks to grip it.
I'm keeping this one.
Neck low, picking carefully.
There's a bug in the grass. I see it.
I cock my head and freeze.
Wings half spread, ready to fly.
The flock draws in around me.
Your shadow is enormous.
I give a brief cluck.
I back toward the coop's corner.
My neck stretches long.
I've scratched the soil loose under me.
I don't squawk; I just stretch my neck.

lines.zh: 一只眼看着你，另一只看路
lines.en: One eye on you, one on my exit.
I circle around the yard.
Every step keeps an escape open.
The flock has scattered.
My wings twitch and settle.
I puff my chest out.
You move, I withdraw.
My feet never quite stop.
I'm circling a little wide.
I can take off any moment.
I fly up and peck your boot.
My wing slaps the back of your hand.
My claws push off you.
One peck, then I run.
I bite down on your trouser leg.
My feathers puff to make me look bigger.
I hop and cluck at the same time.
Missed. That was meant to scare you.
Tail half spread, I crouch low.
Then back to the coop I go.
A fancy chicken pops out of the grass.
I shake my feathers out first.
My claws land and hold.

lines.zh: 太阳照在最亮的尾羽上
lines.en: Sunlight finds my brightest tail feather.
I clear my throat and call once.
Other chickens answer nearby.
I dip my head, hunting bugs right away.
This yard looks livable.
I take two careful steps.
Tail up, I look rather fine.
The flame curls my feathers up.
My claws go limp.
I flail and sink in the water.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀得翻了个身
lines.en: The blast flips me over.
Something clipped my tail feathers.
This force makes my head swim.
Too hungry to even cluck.
Lightning stands all my feathers up.
I look down and there's nothing.
